Provenance & Story

From the hills
of Parma

For over 800 years, Parmigiano Reggiano has been produced in exactly the same region of northern Italy, by the same method, under the same strict laws. No shortcuts. No substitutes.

"The most strictly regulated food in the world — and the most worth it."

Only 300 authorised dairies exist worldwide. Every wheel must pass inspection by the Consorzio del Parmigiano Reggiano before it can carry the name. We work directly with family caseifici in Parma, selecting wheels aged to precise maturity, broken by hand using the traditional almond knife that follows the grain of the cheese — never cut.
